# DrPlay player shortcuts

**Source of truth: `src/player/commands.ts`.** This file is generated by hand but
must match it — the context menu and the keyboard both read labels/shortcuts from
the registry, so a shortcut only has to change there.

Every action goes through one command id (`PLAYER_*`), so the context menu, the
player bar and the keyboard can never drift apart.

| Shortcut | Command id | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `Space` | `PLAYER_PLAY_PAUSE` | Play / Pause |
| `S` | `PLAYER_STOP` | Stop (pause + seek to start) |
| `P` | `PLAYER_PREVIOUS` | Previous track |
| `N` | `PLAYER_NEXT` | Next track |
| `Left` | `PLAYER_SEEK_BACKWARD_5` | Seek −5 s |
| `Shift+Left` | `PLAYER_SEEK_BACKWARD_1` | Exact seek −1 s |
| `Right` | `PLAYER_SEEK_FORWARD_5` | Seek +5 s |
| `Shift+Right` | `PLAYER_SEEK_FORWARD_1` | Exact seek +1 s |
| `Up` | `PLAYER_SEEK_FORWARD_60` | Seek +60 s |
| `Down` | `PLAYER_SEEK_BACKWARD_60` | Seek −60 s |
| `F` | `PLAYER_FULLSCREEN` | Enter / exit fullscreen (opens the player if closed) |
| `A` | `PLAYER_AUDIO_NEXT` | Next audio track |
| `Shift+A` | `PLAYER_AUDIO_PREV` | Previous audio track |
| `V` | `PLAYER_SUBTITLE_NEXT` | Next subtitle track |
| `Shift+V` | `PLAYER_SUBTITLE_VISIBLE` | Toggle subtitle visibility |
| `M` | `PLAYER_MUTE` | Mute / unmute |
| `Ctrl+Up` | `PLAYER_VOLUME_UP` | Volume +10 % |
| `Ctrl+Down` | `PLAYER_VOLUME_DOWN` | Volume −10 % |
| `G` | `PLAYER_SUB_DELAY_DOWN` | Subtitle delay −50 ms |
| `H` | `PLAYER_SUB_DELAY_UP` | Subtitle delay +50 ms |
| `Shift+H` | `PLAYER_SUB_DELAY_RESET` | Reset subtitle delay |
| `Ctrl+Alt+Left` | `PLAYER_AUDIO_DELAY_DOWN` | Audio delay −100 ms |
| `Ctrl+Alt+Right` | `PLAYER_AUDIO_DELAY_UP` | Audio delay +100 ms |
| `Ctrl+Alt+Down` | `PLAYER_AUDIO_DELAY_RESET` | Reset audio delay |
| `[` | `PLAYER_SPEED_DOWN` | Slower (0.5× → 2× ladder) |
| `]` | `PLAYER_SPEED_UP` | Faster |
| `=` | `PLAYER_SPEED_NORMAL` | Normal speed (1×) |
| `R` | `PLAYER_ASPECT_CYCLE` | Cycle aspect ratio (auto → 16:9 → 4:3 → 21:9 → 1:1) |
| `D` | `PLAYER_DEINTERLACE_CYCLE` | Cycle deinterlace (off → auto → on) |
| `Ctrl+0` | `PLAYER_FIT_WINDOW` | Fit to window (reset zoom + pan) |
| `Ctrl+=` | `PLAYER_ZOOM_IN` | Zoom in |
| `Ctrl+-` | `PLAYER_ZOOM_OUT` | Zoom out |
| `Ctrl+S` | `PLAYER_SNAPSHOT` | Take screenshot (saved to your Pictures folder) |
| `I` | `PLAYER_MEDIA_INFO` | Media information dialog |
| `L` | `PLAYER_AB_LOOP` | A-B loop: set A → set B → clear |
| `F8` | `PLAYER_QUEUE_TOGGLE` | Show / hide the play queue (alias: `Ctrl+Q`) |
| `Ctrl+Shift+S` | `PLAYER_SHUFFLE` | Toggle shuffle |
| `Escape` | — | Layered: close the media-info dialog → leave fullscreen → close the player |

Notes:

- Shortcuts are ignored while a text field has focus (search boxes, rename inputs).
- Seek, volume, speed, subtitle delay and zoom repeat when the key is held; the
  other commands act once.
- The browser's own `Ctrl+S` / `Ctrl+0` / `Ctrl+±` / `Ctrl+Arrow` defaults are
  suppressed so they reach the player.
- Nothing here is bound inside mpv: the sidecar starts with
  `--input-default-bindings=no` and `--input-vo-keyboard=no`, so there is exactly
  one command path per action.
